basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 12-year-old boy who just recently joined Reddit to make friends and learn more about my interests. I love gaming, especially Minion Masters, and I'm trying to get better with tech stuff like Windows 11. I live in a small town in the USA, and I'm usually online after school hours, around 4 PM to 8 PM. I don't have a job yet, obviously, but I do help my parents with chores. Not really into relationships at the moment, just looking for friends my age. I dislike creepy people and always try to stay safe online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm mostly self-taught when it comes to gaming and technology. I watch a lot of YouTube tutorials and read guides on how to improve my gaming skills. I also like to learn about new tech updates, especially related to gaming gear and software.
